'''Hallaf''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who owned [[Meliflar Station]]. After [[Abeloth]]'s visit to the [[Space station/Legends|station]] and her infection of his daughter, [[Fala (Human)|Fala]], his crew, led by [[Cardya]], mutinied against him. He was put into the brig along with his daughter. There, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], found them. He pleaded with the Jedi to help his daughter and gave them the access codes to his station. After [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Skywalker had healed Fala, he was grateful for his help and for not reporting them to the authorities.
